package check_clair_scan_reports

import data.lib
import data.lib.tekton

# description: Verify the clair-scan task produces vulnerability REPORTS.

#   short_name: has_reports

#

	some att in lib.pipelinerun_attestations
	some task in tekton.tasks(att)
	task.name == "clair-scan"
	not _has_result(task, "REPORTS")
	result := lib.result_helper_with_term(
		rego.metadata.chain(),
		[task.name, "REPORTS"],
		task.name,
	)

	some result in tekton.task_results(task)
	result.name == name
}
